problems.display: y ∝ x². When x = 2, y = 12. Find k.

misconceptions.expect_note: Student treats as y = kx (direct, not squared): k = 12 ÷ 2 = 6.

problems.display: y = 5x². Find y when x = 3.

misconceptions.expect_note: Student computes 5 × 3 = 15 (forgets to square x first).

problems.display: y = 2x². Find y when x = 4.

misconceptions.expect_note: Student computes 2 × 4 = 8 (forgets to square x first).

problems.display: y ∝ x². When x = 5, y = 75. Find k.

misconceptions.expect_note: Student treats as y = kx (direct, not squared): k = 75 ÷ 5 = 15.

problems.display: y = 4√x. Find y when x = 9.

misconceptions.expect_note: Student forgets to take the square root and computes 4 × 9 = 36.

problems.display: y = 48/x. Find y when x = 6.

misconceptions.expect_note: Student multiplies instead of divides: 48 × 6 = 288.

problems.display: y = 7x². Find x when y = 63.

misconceptions.expect_note: Student stops at x² = 9 and gives 9 as the answer (forgets to square root).

problems.display: y ∝ x². When x = 1, y = 6. Find y when x = 4.

misconceptions.expect_note: Student scales linearly: x increased by factor 4 so y = 6 × 4 = 24 (ignores squaring).

problems.display: y ∝ x². When x = 3, y = 27. Find y when x = 7.

misconceptions.expect_note: Student scales linearly: y/27 = 7/3, so y = 27 × 7/3 = 63 (treats as direct proportion, not squared).

problems.display: y ∝ √x. When x = 25, y = 15. Find y when x = 64.

misconceptions.expect_note: Student treats as y ∝ x (direct, not square root): k = 15/25 = 0.6, y = 0.6 × 64 = 38.4.

problems.display: y ∝ 1/x. When x = 4, y = 10. Find y when x = 8.

misconceptions.expect_note: Student treats as direct proportion: k = y/x = 10/4 = 2.5, y = 2.5 × 8 = 20.

problems.display: y ∝ x². When x = 4, y = 48. Find x when y = 108.

misconceptions.expect_note: Student stops at x² = 36 and gives 36 as the answer (forgets to square root).

problems.display: y ∝ x³. When x = 2, y = 40. Find y when x = 3.

misconceptions.expect_note: Student uses x² instead of x³: k = 40/4 = 10, y = 10 × 9 = 90.

problems.display: y ∝ 1/x². When x = 2, y = 5. Find y when x = 5.

misconceptions.expect_note: Student uses 1/x instead of 1/x²: k = 5 × 2 = 10, y = 10 ÷ 5 = 2.

problems.display: y ∝ √x. When x = 4, y = 10. Find x when y = 25.

misconceptions.expect_note: Student stops at √x = 5 and gives x = 5 (forgets to square to recover x).

problems.display: y ∝ 1/x². When x = 3, y = 4. Find y when x = 6.

misconceptions.expect_note: Student uses 1/x instead of 1/x²: k = 4 × 3 = 12, y = 12 ÷ 6 = 2.

problems.display: y ∝ x³. When x = 2, y = 24. Find x when y = 192.

misconceptions.expect_note: Student stops at x³ = 64 and gives 64 as the answer (forgets to cube root).

problems.display: A ∝ r². When r = 3, A = 36π. Find A when r = 5. Give your answer as a multiple of π. (multiple_choice)

misconceptions.expect_note: Most natural error (k = 36π/3 = 12π, A = 12π × 5 = 60π) does not match any option. No determinate wrong-option available.

problems.display: T ∝ √L. When L = 4, T = 1.2. Find L when T = 3.

misconceptions.expect_note: Student stops at √L = 5 and gives L = 5 (forgets to square to recover L).

problems.display: y ∝ 1/√x. When x = 9, y = 4. Find y when x = 144.

misconceptions.expect_note: Student uses x instead of √x: k = 4 × 9 = 36, y = 36 ÷ 144 = 0.25.
